name: Jeeter | Double Rainbow | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Double Rainbow is an indica strain with a bold, sweet aroma layered with citrus and ripe fruit. The dry hit reveals juicy berries and a tangy mango-sour finish, adding depth to the flavor. On the inhale, expect a mix of sweet berries with a subtle sour edge and fruity undertones. A flavorful strain that delivers complexity from the first pull to the last.
